title: Pontotoc parade entries close Monday. Two Chamber notices give different start times
excerpt: The Dec. 7 parade is listed at 6 p.m. on the Chamber’s deadline flyer and at 6:30 p.m. in its registration notice. The printed entry paperwork sets a noon deadline Monday.
locality: City of Pontotoc, Mississippi, and the Chamber office at 109 N. Main St.

facts.evidence: Read the time on the green deadline flyer and compared it with the form heading in the later original post. Both give Dec. 7 and the Nov. 23 entry deadline.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Christmas parade entries are due Monday, Nov. 23. Anyone planning to watch or ride in the Dec. 7 parade should check the start time with the Chamber. Its Monday morning deadline flyer says 6 p.m., while the registration notice it posted an hour later says 6:30 p.m.

The printed entry paperwork sets noon Monday as the deadline. The Chamber’s online form lists Nov. 23 without an hour. The entry rules set the charge at $25 per float, walking group or car club, and $10 per horse.

The theme is “A Very Merry Christmas.” Applicants can follow the Google registration link in the Chamber’s later notice. The form asks for the entry type and a sentence the announcer can read about it. Printed forms go to the Chamber at 109 N. Main St. in Pontotoc.
For a start-time or entry question, the Chamber lists 662-489-5042 and chamber@pontotocchamber.com. Both Monday notices identify the same parade date.
